events.title: Film Restored - Film Heritage Festival
events.description: The Film Heritage Festival shows films from bygone eras that have been restored, presenting restored lost films from different countries to the public.

events.title: Berlin Autumn Carnival
events.description: A ghost train, a giant swing and bumper cars: the Berlin Autumn Fair returns to the Zentraler Festplatz on Kurt-Schumacher-Damm.

events.title: Hauptstadtwiesn at Spinner-Brücke
events.description: With Paulaner beer and a band playing traditional folk music, the Oktoberfest celebration "Hauptstadtwiesn" brings Bavarian atmosphere to Berlin.

events.title: Oktoberfest at Spandau Citadel
events.description: Every Friday and Saturday, the capital's marquee at Spandau Citadel is a hive of activity with Bavarian beer and food.

events.title: Ostpro Berlin
events.description: Numerous companies from eastern Germany present their products and services at the sales fair for eastern products.

events.title: Manga & Entertainment Expo
events.description: For three days, the Manga & Entertainment Expo at Messe Berlin presents everything around manga, anime, Japanese pop culture and lifestyle.

events.title: WeinBerlin
events.description: At WeinBerlin, winemakers and wineries present their best and latest wine creations.

events.title: Jazzfest Berlin
events.description: Integrated into the Berliner Festspiele, Jazzfest Berlin is the crowning finale of every jazz year, with a varied four-day program for jazz lovers.

events.title: Festival of Lights
events.description: Once a year, Berlin's world famous sights and monuments in the city centre become the canvas for spectacular light and video projections.

events.title: Autumn Market at Domäne Dahlem
events.description: Colorful leaves, fresh air and golden light: the Domäne Dahlem invites visitors to its autumn market at the end of October.
